title: Persist gateway RPL DAO replay and routing state across lichend restarts
description: rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs fixes RplStack to MemStorage and Gateway::new always calls RplStack::provision_root. lichend already opens FileStorage for identity/epoch but does not give durable storage to Gateway. Every restart consequently discards DAO origin high-water/admission/routing state and provisions a fresh root, defeating the crash-safe DAO replay requirements. Make Gateway own/open durable NonVolatile storage, select provision vs open consistently with identity creation, and add restart/replay-floor tests.
